∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Ring.{u_1} A] {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype.{u_2} ι] {V : ι → Type u_3}
  [inst_2 : (i : ι) → AddCommGroup.{u_3} (V i)] [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Module.{u_1, u_3} A (V i)]
  [∀ (i : ι), IsSimpleModule.{u_1, u_3} A (V i)] (n : ι → Nat),
  (∀ ⦃i j : ι⦄,
      Nonempty.{u_3 + 1} (LinearEquiv.{u_1, u_1, u_3, u_3} (RingHom.id.{u_1} A) (V i) (V j)) → Eq.{u_2 + 1} i j) →
    ∀ (W : Submodule.{u_1, max u_3 u_2} A (DirectSum.{u_2, u_3} ι fun i => Fin (n i) → V i)),
      Exists.{u_2 + 1} fun r =>
        Exists.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)} fun φ =>
          Exists.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)} fun e =>
            And (∀ (i : ι), LE.le.{0} (r i) (n i))
              (And (∀ (i : ι), Function.Injective.{u_3 + 1, u_3 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{u_3 + 1, u_3 + 1, u_3 + 1} (φ i)))
                (And
                  (∀ (i : ι),
                    LinearIndependent.{0, u_3, u_3} (MulOpposite.{u_3} (Module.End.{u_1, u_3} A (V i)))
                      (DFunLike.coe.{u_3 + 1, u_3 + 1, u_3 + 1}
                        (Etingof.Remark315.homMatrixEquiv.{u_1, u_3} (r i) (n i)) (φ i)))
                  (∀ (w : Subtype.{(max u_2 u_3) + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{max u_2 u_3, max u_2 u_3} W x) (i : ι),
                    Eq.{u_3 + 1}
                      (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1), u_2 + 1, u_3 + 1}
                        (Subtype.val.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)} w) i)
                      (DFunLike.coe.{u_3 + 1, u_3 + 1, u_3 + 1} (φ i)
                        (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1), u_2 + 1, u_3 + 1}
                          (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1), max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1), max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)} e w)
                          i)))))

∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : Ring.{u_1} A] {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype.{u_2} ι] {V : ι → Type u_3}
  [inst_2 : (i : ι) → AddCommGroup.{u_3} (V i)] [inst_3 : (i : ι) → Module.{u_1, u_3} A (V i)]
  [∀ (i : ι), IsSimpleModule.{u_1, u_3} A (V i)] (n : ι → Nat),
  (∀ ⦃i j : ι⦄,
      Nonempty.{u_3 + 1} (LinearEquiv.{u_1, u_1, u_3, u_3} (RingHom.id.{u_1} A) (V i) (V j)) → Eq.{u_2 + 1} i j) →
    ∀ (W : Submodule.{u_1, max u_3 u_2} A (DirectSum.{u_2, u_3} ι fun i => Fin (n i) → V i)),
      Exists.{u_2 + 1} fun r =>
        Exists.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)} fun X =>
          Exists.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)} fun e =>
            And (∀ (i : ι), LE.le.{0} (r i) (n i))
              (And
                (∀ (i : ι), LinearIndependent.{0, u_3, u_3} (MulOpposite.{u_3} (Module.End.{u_1, u_3} A (V i))) (X i))
                (∀ (w : Subtype.{(max u_2 u_3) + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{max u_2 u_3, max u_2 u_3} W x) (i : ι)
                  (l : Fin (n i)),
                  Eq.{u_3 + 1}
                    (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1), u_2 + 1, u_3 + 1} (Subtype.val.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)} w)
                      i l)
                    (Finset.sum.{0, u_3} Finset.univ.{0} fun a =>
                      DFunLike.coe.{u_3 + 1, u_3 + 1, u_3 + 1} (X i a l)
                        (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1), u_2 + 1, u_3 + 1}
                          (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1), max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1), max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)} e w)
                          i a))))
